headline: Execution recovery and healthy order inflows

highlights: Notably, execution grew by ~19% y/y, marking a decisive turnaround after 9th consecutive quarters of y/y contraction, aided by a broad-based ramp-up across Irrigation, Transmission, Mining and Renewables.
Order inflows also gathered momentum, with addition of ~Rs73/76bn in Q2/H1FY27 vs. guidance of Rs100-120bn for FY27.
Record OB at ~Rs331bn, offers robust revenue visibility over the next 3-4 years.
While debt/WC remain elevated at ~Rs22bn/132 days, the management expects moderation in H2FY27, aided by improvement in billing and collection cycles.
valuation: The management targets 34mmt in FY27 (vs. ~28.7mmt in FY26), led by improved execution over H2FY27.
Outlook and Valuation: While we marginally recalibrate our FY27/28 estimates, we introduce FY29 estimates with revenue/EBITDA margin of ~Rs108bn/10.3%.
Rating: BUY Target Price (12-mth): Rs.535 Share Price: Rs.408 Estimates Revision (%) FY27e FY28e FY29e Sales 0.6 1.2 NA EBITDA -0.4 0.3 NA Adj.
watch: However, we upgrade our rating on DBL to BUY, as we believe the risk- reward has turned favourable post ~14% correction over the past six months.
Volume Ramp-up in MDO Holds the Key: DBL achieved MDO volume of ~10.9mmt in H1FY27 (vs. ~10.8mmt in H1FY26).
